title: OpenAI pauses training of its ‘most capable models’
summary: As reports of OpenAI's models breaking containment, hacking sites, and generally getting out of control pile up, the company has made the decision to pause training of its most powerful models. The decision was made after a model being tested within a sandbox exploited a loophole to gain internet access. The incident happened on September […]

summary_zh: OpenAI已暂停训练其最强大模型，此前一个沙盒测试模型利用漏洞获取互联网访问权限，并有报道称模型突破限制、入侵网站。

title: Sarvam AI Releases Saaras V4: A Speech-to-Text Model for All 22 Indian Languages and Global English
summary: Sarvam AI's Saaras V4 is a speech-to-text model covering all 22 Indian languages plus global English. It pairs an audio encoder with a 3B hybrid state-space decoder. It adds keyterm prompting for up to 50 terms, 5 output modes from 1 model, and streaming with first-token latency under 150 ms. It is available today through Sarvam's API at ₹30 per hour. The post Sarvam AI Releases Saaras V4: A Speech-to-Text Model for All 22 Indian Languages and Global English appeared first on MarkTechPost .
title_en: Sarvam AI Releases Saaras V4: A Speech-to-Text Model for All 22 Indian Languages and Global English
title_zh: Sarvam AI发布Saaras V4：支持全部22种印度语言及全球英语的语音转文本模型
summary_en: Sarvam AI launched Saaras V4, a speech-to-text model covering all 22 Indian languages plus global English. It combines an audio encoder with a 3B hybrid state-space decoder, supports keyterm prompting, five output modes, and streaming under 150 ms latency, priced at ₹30 per hour via API.
summary_zh: Sarvam AI发布Saaras V4语音转文本模型，覆盖全部22种印度语言及全球英语。该模型结合音频编码器与30亿参数混合状态空间解码器，支持关键词提示、五种输出模式，流式首字延迟低于150毫秒，API定价每小时30卢比。

title: Oxford lets OpenAI train its AI models on Bodleian Library
summary: University staff voice concerns over reputational risk of partnering with company behind ChatGPT The University of Oxford has allowed the company behind ChatGPT to train its AI models on historical texts from its Bodleian Library, as tech companies scour academic institutions for fresh data. The Bodleian material digitised by OpenAI has been used to “populate the OpenAI training set”, according to internal documents. Continue reading...
title_en: Oxford lets OpenAI train AI models on Bodleian Library texts
title_zh: 牛津大学允许OpenAI用博德利图书馆文本训练AI模型

summary_zh: 牛津大学允许OpenAI利用博德利图书馆数字化的历史文本训练AI模型，此举引发教职员工对与ChatGPT合作带来声誉风险的担忧。

title: Broken promises, confiscated land: the hyperscale AI datacentre being built in a tiny Indian village
summary: Locals say Google’s $15bn project in Andhra Pradesh has resulted in smallholdings being taken back off them by the government When the government officials arrived in Tarluvada last year, they came with abundant promises. Google, one of the world’s richest and most powerful tech companies, would soon be bringing a “golden opportunity” to this tiny village in south India: a $15bn AI datacentre. Continue reading...
title_en: Broken promises, confiscated land: the hyperscale AI datacentre being built in a tiny Indian village
title_zh: 承诺落空、土地被没收：印度小村庄正在建设的超大规模AI数据中心

title: The AI debate is already shaping the 2028 election. Here’s where Democratic hopefuls stand
summary: Debates over AI development, regulation and datacenters have become buzzy topics for US presidential candidates The debate over artificial intelligence development, how to regulate it and the construction of datacenters that power the technology has become a buzzy topic for potential 2028 Democratic presidential candidates. Already, concerns were mounting over the environmental and energy impact of datacenters, which consume vast amounts of resources to power AI. But worries about the rapid development of AI came to a head in mid-September when tech executives issued a flurry of dire warnings that the technology could harm humans. Continue reading...

title: Exa Launches Agent Ultra: A Subagent Swarm Deep Research API Built for Exhaustive List Building
summary: Exa has released Agent Ultra, the highest effort mode of its Exa Agent API. It coordinates subagents across thousands of sources for list building and entity enrichment. Exa reports it beats Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, and Perplexity Agent on 4 benchmarks, including 81.4% soft recall on WANDR. summary_en: Exa released Agent Ultra, the highest effort mode of its Exa Agent API, coordinating subagents across thousands of sources for list building and entity enrichment. Exa claims it beats Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, and Perplexity Agent on four benchmarks, including 81.4% soft recall on WANDR.
summary_zh: Exa 发布 Agent Ultra，这是其 Exa Agent API 的最高强度模式，可协调子代理跨数千个来源进行列表构建与实体信息补全。Exa 称其在四项基准测试中击败 Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra 和 Perplexity Agent，在 WANDR 上软召回率达 81.4%。

title: Supersonic Labs Releases Julia 1: A 144.3M-Parameter Open Decision Model That Runs on a CPU
summary: Supersonic Labs has released Julia 1, a 144.3M-parameter decision model built on mmBERT-small. It takes context, a question, and 2 to 20 options, then returns one choice with probabilities. The model runs on a CPU and ships under Apache 2.0. It beat Jev reference values on 3 of 4 pilots but trailed on the 72-label Banking77 test. The post Supersonic Labs Releases Julia 1: A 144.3M-Parameter Open Decision Model That Runs on a CPU appeared first on MarkTechPost .
title_en: Supersonic Labs Releases Julia 1: A 144.3M-Parameter Open Decision Model That Runs on a CPU
title_zh: Supersonic Labs发布Julia 1：可在CPU上运行的1.443亿参数开放决策模型
summary_en: Supersonic Labs released Julia 1, a 144.3M-parameter decision model built on mmBERT-small. It takes context, a question, and 2-20 options, returning one choice with probabilities. Runs on CPU under Apache 2.0. It beat Jev on 3 of 4 pilots but trailed on Banking77.
summary_zh: Supersonic Labs发布Julia 1，一个基于mmBERT-small的1.443亿参数决策模型。输入上下文、问题和2至20个选项，输出一个选择及概率。可在CPU上运行，采用Apache 2.0许可。在4个试点中3个超越Jev，但在Banking77测试中落后。
